pages.title: Drop Rules
pages.text: Killing a royal-shield enemy with the matching affix has a very small chance to yield its material. Even if several checks succeed, one kill retains at most one affix material.$(br2)Shield-bound materials do not drop when an Armor-Piercing Arrow removes the shield. Lifelong affixes follow their own checks.

pages.title: Rage, Molten, Forfeit
pages.text: $(li)Rage: Calming Tibia$(li)Molten: Pitchfire Crystal$(li)Blood Forfeit: Heart-Devouring Remnant$(br2)Pitchfire can be consumed directly; the other two are advanced crafting materials.

pages.title: Claw, Feast, Miasma
pages.text: $(li)Claw Rage: Ravenous Claw Fragment$(li)Flesh Feast: Famine Core$(li)Miasma: Venom Orb$(br2)Each material preserves a remnant of its defeated affix.

pages.title: Restoration, Limit, Authority
pages.text: $(li)Restoration: Ka Remnant Breath$(li)Blood Limit: Life-Binding Remnant Crystal$(li)Death Authority: Authority Fragment$(br2)The Life-Binding Remnant Crystal is also a core ingredient of Eternal Conquest.

pages.title: Vulnerability and Counter
pages.text: $(li)Vulnerability: Truth$(li)Counter: Reverse Scale$(br2)Every material's enable switch and drop chance can be configured independently in the common config.
